title: Self-Massage — 10 Minutes
summary: A short sequence for the shoulders, forearms, hands, and scalp.
goal: Combine gentle techniques into a short daily break.
startingPosition: Sit stably, relax the shoulders, and keep the neck neutral.
direction: From shoulders to arms and scalp, then a gradual finish.
warning: This educational routine is not treatment. Do not perform it with contraindications, acute pain, recent injury, inflammation, or worsening wellbeing.
